title: W1 SEMANTIC PROFILE

implementationResponsibilities.capture: producer / initial prospective allocator implementation location

directionEvidence.standing: approves finalisation direction, NOT this exact publication

statusRule: Controlled specification on competent Owner-authorised verified publication; candidate before that event
effectivityRule: Effective for W1 DEVELOPMENT / CONFORMANCE at the verified Owner-authorised atomic publication revision; no invented date or containing hash
operationalApplicability: NOT established by publication; exact real format, issuer/allocator, principal/grant, policy and deployment applicability required before corresponding real use
implementationAuthorisation: NONE conveyed by this specification or its publication
subject: Match Occurrence is operational root; Fixture, Session, Run and representation are distinct
correspondence: Explicit issuer-qualified resolution record; no equality/similarity/import inference; reversals preserve prior effectivity and basis
canonicalIdentity: Accepted ADR-AMHARC-006 Profile v1; provisionally allocated occurrence remains the same occurrence ID on confirmation

officialTime.coordinate: non-negative accumulated playing time under exact Match Format
officialTime.corrections: Only explicit authorised attributable correction may reduce time; prior value and provenance remain
officialTime.period: Explicit format period key and known accumulated start boundary; elapsed = accumulated - boundary; never infer later-period boundary
officialTime.intervals: No playing-time accumulation in preplay, interval or completed phase

formatApplicability: Consume externally supplied exact format/period records; no hard-coded p1/p2, count, duration or competition rules. No general Match Format authoring platform.
formatGovernance: Real governed format is NOT required for generic fail-closed development; REQUIRED for the operational use depending on that format.
legacyRecording: Copy current producer recordingElapsedSeconds unchanged, with v1/legacy qualification; not Run elapsed, Session elapsed, Asset time, footage duration or Match Time

authority.principal: governed operational responsibility, not process instance or application name
authority.binding: exact subject/domain/capability/effectivity grant and complete scoped control-plane evidence
authority.incarnation: execution lifetime; restart creates another incarnation and needs explicit eligibility, never automatic binding carry-over
authority.ordering: generation/sequence compare only within same subject/principal/binding/incarnation; decimal strings avoid JS precision loss
authority.activation: explicit approved activation baseline; no election, reconnect promotion or general transfer
authority.gap: no eligible verifiable authority; withhold official progression; last observation stays historical
authority.conflict: unresolved governance-incompatible competing grants; no arbitrary winner

observer: Tagger read-only; no reducer clock overwrite, score effect, Event acceptance or authority promotion; label last observed as-of, not guaranteed current
missingness: Required omission invalid; null is explicit unavailable/unknown in the field's stated domain. For Gap/Conflict, nonempty reason plus withheld state mandatory. Unsupported dependency quarantines without default substitution.
quality: UTC observation is not monotonic observation; checkpoint restore/UTC reconstruction remain distinct and uncertainty may be unknown
offline: Exact content-addressed local dependency bundle only; no latest/default/network fallback; incomplete scope or expired trust bundle withholds authority
authorityInterpretation: Envelope capability snapshot means emission ONLY. Advance/pause-resume/correct/period-transition/checkpoint/recover eligibility is established separately in exact material activity / grant context; never inferred from snapshot permission.
qualification: Emission integrity, state-transition authority, applicability, observation currentness, identity resolution, history support and Event acceptance are separate findings.
betaMaturity: Capture Beta/active development; Tagger Beta/field-test capable with limited live-match use; neither production/Foundation conformance established
